title: Von der Datenbasis zur KI-gestützten Entscheidungsfindung: Die Erfolgsgeschichte von Zgonc mit Insider One
description:
Der österreichische DIY- und Baumarkt-Händler Zgonc begegnet dem Rückgang der Kundenfrequenz im stationären Handel mit einer klaren Strategie für die Zukunft. Erfahren Sie, wie das Unternehmen mit Insider One eine einheitliche Customer Data Platform aufgebaut, die Migration zu Shopify erfolgreich gemeistert und den Grundstein für KI-gestützte Entscheidungen in Echtzeit gelegt hat – über Suche, Merchandising und Kundenkommunikation hinweg.

Entdecken Sie, wie eine moderne Datenbasis nachhaltiges Wachstum ermöglicht und warum die Zukunft des Handels in KI-Systemen liegt, die nicht nur Empfehlungen geben, sondern eigenständig Entscheidungen treffen.

title: Job Killer or Team Multiplier? The Truth About Agentic Data and Experience Management
description:
Is agentic AI coming for your team's jobs, or is it about to make them ten times more valuable? This session gives you the honest answer, not the hype.

See how agentic AI already runs across Pimcore's PIM, MDM, DAM and DXP: managing data, building data models, running workflows, creating templates, driving personalization. Always with a human in the loop. Always fully governed.

That's the real answer to "job killer or team multiplier": it depends on where you draw the line between what AI executes and what your team decides. This talk draws that line with real customer cases.

You'll leave knowing:

Which tasks agentic PIM, MDM, DAM and DXP already handle end to endWhere humans still make the call, and why that boundary is the whole pointWhat shifts in your team's day-to-day work, and what doesn'tHow early adopters measure the ROI of going agentic 

No theory. No filler. Just what agentic data and experience management actually changes for your team.

title: Canva & Deutsche Post: Why Human Judgement Is Your Sharpest AI Advantage
description:
AI budgets are up. Content output is up. Consumer trust is not. Canva's State of Marketing and AI 2026 Report surveyed over 5,000 marketing leaders and consumers across Europe, and the signal is consistent: audiences can spot AI slop, and they're switching off.

The teams winning aren't producing less. They're producing with direction. Daniela Nyarko unpacks what the data reveals about where human judgement sits in the AI-powered marketing mix, then sits down with Janine Langlotz from DHL to explore how to turn scale into a genuine competitive edge.

title: Performance at Scale: Wie Tchibo eine wachstumsstarke Strategie jenseits der Walled Gardens aufbaut
description: Was braucht es tatsächlich, um effizient zu skalieren? In dieser Masterclass präsentiert Tchibo Einblicke in ihre Erfolgsstrategie für inkrementelles Wachstum. Mit Realize, der Performance-Marketing-Plattform von Taboola, skaliert die Brand ihre Kundenakquise jenseits der Walled Gardens – im Open Web. Ein Deep Dive ins Kampagnen-Setup zeigt die zentralen Treiber hinter dem profitablen Budgetwachstum von 80 % (YoY): automatisierte Budget-Steuerung, minimierter Ad-Waste, vielfältige Ad-Formate und inkrementelle Conversions. Die Session liefert dir das Praxiswissen, um neue Wachstumshebel zu aktivieren.

title: Masterclass Snapchat x L'Oréal: Ads im Chat - Von der Inbox zum Attention-Booster mit Snapchat & L'Oréal
description: Wie gelingt der Schritt von unaufmerksamer Mediennutzung zu echter Interaktion in hochfrequentierten Kommunikationsräumen? Im Rahmen der Revitalift-Kampagne nutzte L’Oréal Paris als einer der ersten Marken in Deutschland das neue Werbeformat direkt im Chat-Feed von Snapchat. Die Case Study zeigt, wie die Kombination aus Creator-led Sponsored Snaps, gewohnten Interaktionsmustern und begleitenden Video-Assets messbare Mehrwerte schaffte.

speakers.name: Benjamin Kraft
speakers.jobTitle: Head of Media der Consumer Products Division

title: Search Intelligence in Action: How Orange reduced support cost by 23% and improved customer experience
description:
What answers are consumers looking for before they call, click, complain, or convert? In this session, Brandwatch and Orange explore how Search Intelligence reveals real customer intent across search engines, AI assistants, and emerging discovery channels — and how combining these insights with social listening helps brands create smarter, more relevant content.

Using Orange’s work with Trajaan, Brandwatch’s Search Intelligence platform, as a practical example, this panel shows how question data can inform digital marketing, product strategy, and market research — from spotting emerging demand to reducing call center pressure, speeding up content creation, and turning search, social and media insights into measurable business impact.

title: Ist Social Organic underrated? 5 Hebel, mit denen deine Accounts 2027 messbaren Mehrwert schaffen – von Boosting über Content bis Social Listening
description:
Kennst du das Gefühl?

Ihr investiert Zeit in Social Media, postet regelmäßig, probiert Formate aus – und trotzdem bleibt am Ende die Frage offen, was das Ganze dem Unternehmen eigentlich bringt. Reichweite ja, aber messbarer Mehrwert?

Das liegt nicht daran, dass ihr schlechte Arbeit macht. Sondern daran, dass Social in vielen Brands als „Visitenkarte" behandelt wird – nett zu haben, aber ohne klaren Hebel aufs Geschäft. Genau hier trennt sich 2027 die Spreu vom Weizen.

In dieser Masterclass zeigen wir, wie organisches Social heute wirklich einzahlt: nicht als Selbstzweck, sondern als strategischer Wachstumstreiber mit messbarem Impact. Wir gehen weg vom Bauchgefühl und hin zu einem System aus konkreten Hebeln, die ineinandergreifen – von strategischem Boosting über Content bis Social Listening.

Helena (Head of Social Media) und Simon (Gründer und CEO) zeigen euch, wie wir Social bei trafficdesign denken: praxisnah, systematisch und ohne Buzzword-Bingo.

title: From Human to AI Visitors: Why Your Analytics Are Half-Blind
description: Web analytics were built for a world where every visitor was human. That world is gone. Today, AI agents, LLM crawlers, and automated assistants navigate your site alongside real users, and most analytics tools ignore them, because they cannot technically track them through the classic Javascript-based approach. And the solution is not as easy as AI Visibility tools are trying to make it seem. This talk explores how Publytics and Honeylog together rewrite the paradigm. Publytics delivers high-quality, privacy-respecting client-side analytics that capture genuine human behavior. Honeylog works server-side to identify the bots, scrapers, and AI agents that never trigger a browser. Combined, they produce a complete ground truth: who your real audience is, who the machines are, and what each of them is actually doing, influencing each others.

title: Retail & Commerce Media Today: Trends, Growth and the Road Ahead
description:
Retail & Commerce Media have evolved from experimental advertising channels into key pillars of modern marketing strategies. As retailers increasingly monetize their digital touchpoints and first‑party data, brands are shifting an increasing share of their media budgets into retail-owned ecosystems. At the same time, the boundaries between retail, media, and commerce platforms are blurring: marketplaces, delivery platforms, connected stores, and social commerce environments are becoming media channels themselves.
This panel examines current trends in Retail & Commerce Media, shaping the industry today. Panelists will discuss how retailers are building scalable retail media networks, how brands integrate retail media into their broader marketing mix, and why data and closed-loop measurement are critical for success. The conversation will explore the competitive dynamics between retailers, marketplaces, and big tech platforms, as well as the growing need for transparency and standardization. The panel will provide a concise overview of where the market stands today and what companies must do to remain competitive in a rapidly expanding commerce-driven media landscape.

title: The conversation belongs to you again
description: Chat is becoming the highest-converting storefront in commerce. With one billion daily business conversations across chat apps, AI agents now handle discovery, advice, authentication and payment in a single thread. See how companies are innovating and how the customer-lifecycle is leveraged to increase footprint and growth among commerce.

title: KI kann alles produzieren. Wo der Vorsprung 2026 wirklich liegt.
description: Jedes Marketingteam kann heute in einer Stunde produzieren, wofür früher eine Agentur zwei Wochen gebraucht hat. Trotzdem sehen die Ergebnisse in den meisten Abteilungen aus wie vorher. Jens Polomski zeigt, woran das liegt. Nicht an den Modellen, sondern daran, wie Teams mit ihnen arbeiten. 20 Minuten mit Beispielen aus echten Rollouts, den Stellen, an denen es regelmäßig hakt, und dem, was ihr am Montag danach anders macht.

title: AI Creates Content. Humans Create Trust. Why webinars are winning in the age of AI.
description:
AI is making it easier than ever to create blogs, emails, landing pages and social posts. But most digital content is increasingly optimised for algorithms rather than people. 

Webinars are different. They remain one of the few digital formats built around real human attention, interaction and trust. A place where you can truly demonstrate knowledge and expertise whilst engaging with your audience.

This session explores how marketers can use AI to enhance the human side of webinars instead of replacing it.

Key takeaways:

* Why human attention is becoming the scarcest asset in digital marketing
* How AI can improve webinar planning, personalisation, and engagement
* Practical ways to scale authentic audience experiences without losing the human touch
* Why live human interaction is outperforming traditional content marketing

title: Everyone Can Make Anything. Now What?
description: Generative systems have removed most of the barriers that once separated an idea from its execution. Craft and production budget no longer decide what gets made. What stays scarce is judgment: knowing what deserves to exist at all, and why one version moves an audience while a technically stronger one leaves it cold. Some Food for Thought where creative value migrates once output becomes abundant, and which parts of the creative process remain stubbornly human.

title: Creative First - Die richtige Idee im richtigen Moment
description:
Daten und KI können Kampagnen optimieren – Aufmerksamkeit entsteht aber erst durch relevante Kreation. Gerade im DOOH entscheidet dabei nicht nur, was wir zeigen, sondern zunehmend auch, wann, wo und in welcher Situation eine Botschaft ausgespielt wird, damit sie wirklich wirkt. Das Panel diskutiert, wie starke kreative Ideen mit Dynamic Creative Optimization und situativen Echtzeitdaten zusammenspielen: Wie verändert sich Kreation, wenn Wetter, Tageszeit, Standort, Events oder andere aktuelle Situationen bestimmen, welches Motiv gerade relevant ist? Und wie lassen sich aus einer starken Leitidee unterschiedliche Botschaften entwickeln, die sich dynamisch an den jeweiligen Moment anpassen? Im Mittelpunkt steht die Frage, wie Kreation, Technologie und situative Daten gemeinsam mehr Relevanz erzeugen können – ohne die kreative Idee der Technologie unterzuordnen.

Moderation: Frank Goldberg, IDOOH

Mit airtango media, Cynapsis Media, INOVISCO

speakers.name: Lars Hilsebein
speakers.organization: Cynapsis Media GmbH und Cynapsis Interactive GmbH

speakers.name: Frank Goldberg
speakers.organization: Institute for Digital Out of Home Media

title: Redefining the Screen: Samsung’s Vision for the Future of TV Advertising
description:
TV is changing. But are we still thinking about it in the right way? The world of TV advertising is no longer defined by linear TV. As viewing moves across streaming, CTV, and connected experiences, the traditional boundaries — and silos — are breaking down. What emerges is something bigger: a new TV ecosystem, powered by richer data and new opportunities to reach audiences on the biggest screen in the home.
In this keynote, Christian Russ will unpack the forces reshaping TV viewing and advertising today. Drawing on Samsung’s unique perspective as a leading TV manufacturer, he’ll explore what’s really changed in the shift from linear to CTV — from the technology and interfaces influencing consumer behaviour to the fragmentation challenges facing advertisers.

As the traditional “lean-back” TV experience evolves, so too does the opportunity for brands. Christian will explore how creative new advertising solutions can move beyond simply interrupting the viewing experience to engage audiences, opening up new possibilities for interaction, discovery and impact on the biggest screen in the home. But understanding the new TV landscape is only the beginning. Christian will explore how advertisers can navigate this complexity, unlock the value of new data signals, and make smarter decisions in an increasingly connected world. Looking ahead, what will define TV advertising in 2026? Expect a sharp view of the trends, opportunities, and challenges shaping the next era of TV.

title: Relevanz beginnt mit Verstehen: Wie dm Personalisierung vom Kundenbedürfnis her denkt
description:
Mit über 14 Millionen Kund:innen betreibt dm eine der größten Kundenplattformen Europas. Doch wie lassen sich Millionen von Touchpoints, fragmentierte Datenquellen und unterschiedliche Systeme zu einer konsistenten, relevanten Customer Experience verbinden?

In dieser Session zeigen dm und Entirely, warum die nahtlose Integration von Elaine, an Entirely Company in den Enterprise-MarTech-Stack und das Datenökosystem entscheidend ist – und wie vernetzte Daten, durchgängige Prozesse und intelligentes Customer Engagement echte Personalisierung at Scale ermöglichen.

title: 86% of Gen Z Search on TikTok weekly. 99% of What They Find Isn't Yours.
description: Search has moved to TikTok — 86% of Gen Z start there. But when they search your category, 99% of the videos they find come from creators, not from brands. Refluenced shows how to measure your visibility in social search, and how to change it.

title: A TRULY TERRIFYING AI CASE by SIXT
description: Already last year, SIXT and Jung von Matt asked themselves how the consistently positive reviews for SIXT on Trustpilot could be turned into a campaign. The answer was simple: by taking customers' negative experiences with the competition and turning them into horror movies, just in time for Halloween. With AI as the enabler. Thomas Heyen, creative lead behind the SIXT campaigns and Partner at Jung von Matt in Hamburg, explains how they made it happen.

title: The Agentic Shift: How Blackroll is shaping the future of commerce with Shopify
description: KI verändert Commerce grundlegend: Kund:innen suchen nicht mehr nur, sie formulieren Wünsche, und Agenten handeln darauf.Gemeinsam mit Marius Keckeisen von BLACKROLL zeigt Fabian Muessig von Shopify, was das für Marken jetzt bedeutet: Wie bleibt man sichtbar, relevant und in Kontrolle, wenn Kaufentscheidungen zunehmend in KI-gestützten Gesprächen entstehen? Ein Blick hinter die Kulissen einer Marke, die Commerce schon heute neu denkt und auf die Infrastruktur, die Unternehmen für die nächste Ära brauchen.

title: EU AI ACT - Die 15-Millionen-Euro-Bedrohung
description:
Warum es für Brands zur entscheidenden Frage wird, Human-in-the-Loop-Freigaben und ein AI Content System of Record jetzt zu etablieren

Der EU AI Act erhöht den Druck auf Brands, KI-generierte und KI-unterstützte Inhalte kontrolliert, nachvollziehbar und rechtskonform zu managen. Michael Kräftner zeigt, warum Unternehmen jetzt Human-in-the-Loop-Freigaben und ein AI Content System of Record etablieren müssen, um Content Governance, Rechtekontrolle und Markenkonsistenz skalierbar abzusichern. Anhand zentraler Anforderungen an moderne Content Supply Chains wird deutlich, wie strukturierte Workflows, Metadaten und transparente Freigabeprozesse zur Basis für sicheren KI-Einsatz im Marketing werden.

title: Beer & Pretzels Networking
description:
Join us for our Beer & Pretzels Networking Session!

After an exciting first day of content sessions at DMEXCO, take a breather with the Vistar Media and T Advertising Solutions Germany teams.

Drop by Hall 8.1, booth D-060 for a cold beer, fresh pretzels, and relaxed networking with industry peers to wrap up Day 1. We're looking forward to seeing you there!

title: How to get started with Pinterest Ads
description:
Millions of people come to Pinterest with a clear intent: to discover, plan, and buy. For advertisers, that's an opportunity you don't want to miss. In this session, we'll walk you through everything you need to launch your first Pinterest Ads campaign:

From setup to creative best practices to measuring what matters. Whether you're brand new to Pinterest or looking to level up, you'll leave with actionable insights you can apply right away.

title: Perspektivwechsel für Eure Strategie: 4 Impulse, wie Ihr Premium-Video neu nutzen könnt
description:
Vier Perspektivwechsel, die Kampagnen heute verändern: Professionelle Creator-Formate. Europäische Netzwerke. Funnel-übergreifende Wirkung. Datengetriebene Intelligenz.

In dieser Keynote bekommt Ihr einen Einstieg in alle vier Themen.

Im vierten Impuls wird es konkret: Dominik Thiel, Geschäftsführer gemini Direct, und Heinrich von Hoessle, Director Advanced TV Product bei Seven.One Media, zeigen, wie die neuen Daten-Möglichkeiten von Seven.One Media in der Praxis funktionieren.Für Marketing-Verantwortliche und Agenturen, die ihren Blickwinkel auf Premium-Video verändern wollen – um neue Chancen für ihre Kommunikation zu entdecken.

title: Google Innovation Tour
description:
Sei bei unserer Google Innovation Tour auf der DMEXCO dabei und buch dir deinen Slot direkt auf unserer Website: https://rsvp.withgoogle.com/events/dmexco_26_innovation_tours
(Bookmarks können wir leider nicht als verbindliche Zusage berücksichtigen).

Die Google Innovation Tour rund um unseren Google-Stand bietet dir entscheidende Einblicke in Wettbewerbsvorteile im Zeitalter der KI. Entdecke, wie du mit Google AI starke Ideen entwickeln und diese effektiver und vor allem profitabler umsetzen kannst:

Erschließe neue geschäftliche Potenziale mit  KI-gestützter Suche, Commerce und Ads.

Erkunde die Welt von YouTube und Creator*innen, um deine Full-Funnel-Performance und deinen ROAS zu verbessern.

Erlebe den Gemini-Vorteil, der deine Effizienz durch skalierte Asset-Erstellung und KI-Workspace-Agents erhöht.

Lerne von führenden Partner*innen wie Otto und der Deutschen Bank.

Werde selbst aktiv und teste Tools, mach mit bei unserem interaktiven Measurement-Quiz, besuche die Gemini Photobooth und lass dich vor Ort von unseren Expert*innen beraten.

Jetzt hier buchen: https://rsvp.withgoogle.com/events/dmexco_26_innovation_tours

title: Retail Media in Video: How DocMorris & Havas Market Revolutionize YouTube Campaigns with First-Party Data
description: Retail Media is evolving rapidly. However, demanding technical hurdles and strict regulatory guidelines - especially in sensitive industries like the healthcare sector - often limit its full utilization. Previously, the optimal interplay between Retail Media data and YouTube required an extremely precise alignment of the underlying data and identity layers. For brands and agencies, this posed a significant challenge for data-driven audience targeting in the video space. In this Masterclass, we present an innovative solution: a cross-functional Google team, together with the online pharmacy DocMorris and their agency partner HAVAS Market, has implemented a pioneering technological approach. By implementing Google Customer Match as an additional identity layer within Display & Video 360, this existing interface barrier was successfully dismantled. The result is a solid, fully compliant process that respects regulatory requirements while unlocking new potential for data-driven campaigns on YouTube. Learn, how this collaborative project has created a practical blueprint for the market.

title: Why we buy now: 6 emotional forces shaping future consumer decisions
description:
What will make people choose your brand next? The next purchase decision won’t be won at the point of sale, but at the point of emotion. As consumer expectations shift, the brands that win will understand what people want and what they need to feel. People don’t just buy products. They buy trust, identity, connection and belonging. 
 Here, Birgit Amelung explores six emotional forces shaping consumer choice and loyalty. Drawing on cultural shifts, trend research and work with global brands, she translates human needs into implications for brand, innovation and growth. What will make people trust, choose and stay loyal to brands in 2027 - and how can brands turn this into an advantage?

title: Die Überwindung der „Offline-Blindness“ im Zeitalter der Ergebnisse
description:
Da fast 80 % der Verbrauchertransaktionen nach wie vor in der realen Welt stattfinden, entstehen durch die ausschließliche Konzentration auf Online-Klicks erhebliche Lücken in Ihrer Marketingstrategie.

In dieser Learning Journey wird anhand eines „Outcomes Loop“-Durchlaufs veranschaulicht, wie Marken ihre Ausgaben für digitale Werbung in vier Schlüsselphasen – Planung, Zielgruppenansprache, Optimierung und Validierung – mit nachweisbaren Besucherzahlen in der realen Welt verknüpfen können.

Seien Sie dabei und erfahren Sie, wie Sie Offline-Blindflecken beseitigen und Ihre Werbeausgaben sicher direkt mit messbaren Ergebnissen im stationären Handel verknüpfen können.

 

Wann: Tag 1, 23. September | 15 Uhr 

Speaker: David Luchtenberg | Managing Director | adsquare

Tour-Host: Jan Hendrik Leifker | CEO | Amplio

Bewerbung für Deine Teilnahme 

 

Learning Journeys: Die DMEXCO Learning Journeys bieten Dir kompakte, kuratierte Touren zu relevanten Themen der digitalen Wirtschaft. Besuche ausgewählte Aussteller, erlebe praxisnahe Best Practices und erhalte in nur 30 Minuten konkrete Impulse. Alle Teilnehmer*innen erhalten einen 500 EUR Discount (auf ausgewählte Kurse) für ihre Learning Journey in der BVDW-Academy.

Die DMEXCO Learning Journeys richten sich an Fach- und Führungskräfte sowie Entscheider*innen aus Marketing, Media, E-Commerce und Digital Business, die sich über aktuelle Entwicklungen informieren, Best Practices kennenlernen und sich mit Branchenkolleginnen austauschen möchten.
location: Learning Journeys by BVDW Academy | Boulevard

title: The AI Search Visibility Layer for the New Search Era
description:
Search changed. People now ask AI what to buy, book, and trust, and it answers with a shortlist. If your brand isn't on it, you never find out why.

Trendos is the visibility layer for that shift. Add your brand by name and see exactly how AI engines mention, rank, and recommend you: your share of voice against competitors, the sentiment behind every mention, the sources AI cites when it talks about you, and where you're missing from answers you should own. Ad Radar goes one step further, showing who's already buying ads inside ChatGPT now that AI has become a paid channel across Europe.

 

In this session we'll show what the data reveals about how AI really sees brands, and three moves to start showing up in the answers that matter. That's the present-day picture. For the deeper organic story, catch our masterclass on Day 2.

title: Scaling Intelligence? Remarks and Thoughts by Rezo
description:
As a software entrepreneur and creator, Rezo closely follows economic, social, and technological developments related to artificial intelligence and social media. In a conversation with Emily Whigham, he explains what particularly impresses him and which developments he considers especially relevant.

*** This session will be held in German. ***

title: Google Wallet: accelerating growth in the era of agentic commerce
description: Discover how Google Wallet delivers simple, safe, and smart transactional experiences - enabling merchants and platform partners to leverage current and next-generation Wallet solutions in the era of agentic commerce.

title: Better together: Wie Vermarkter und Infrastrukturpartner gemeinsam Wachstum schaffen
description:
Wachstum braucht nicht nur gute Vermarktung, sondern auch die richtige Infrastruktur. Der Vortrag veranschaulicht, wie eine klare Rollenverteilung zwischen Vermarktern und Infrastrukturpartnern neue Möglichkeiten für die Skalierung von DOOH schafft. Wildstone zeigt, welchen Beitrag ein kapitalstarker Infrastrukturpartner leisten kann: von der Standortentwicklung und Finanzierung über Genehmigung und Installation bis hin zum Betrieb der Screens. So können Vermarkter ihr Kapital und ihre Ressourcen auf das konzentrieren, was sie am besten können – die Vermarktung der DOOH-Flächen und das Wachstum ihres Geschäfts.

Mit Wildstone Germany

title: Instore Advertising: Werbungtreibende fordern - die Retail Media Alliance liefert
description:
Skalierbar, vergleichbar, belegbar – Instore Advertising wird zur festen Größe im Mediaplan.

Die Forderungen der Werbungtreibenden an Retail Media sind klar formuliert: einfachere Buchung, vergleichbare Inventare, nachvollziehbare Wirkungsnachweise. Für Instore Advertising gilt das besonders. Hier belegen einzelne Anbieter seit Jahren die Wirkung ihrer Touchpoints – jeder für sich, mit eigener Methodik und eigenem Reporting.

Auf dieser Bühne treffen beide Seiten aufeinander. Ein Werbungtreibender formuliert die Anforderungen der Nachfrageseite. Die Partner der Retail Media Alliance legen ihre Nachweise nebeneinander: von der Ansprache im Einzugsgebiet über Eingang, Fläche bis zur Coupon-Einlösung am Check-Out auf dem Bon. Sie zeigen, was jeder Touchpoint einzeln leistet – und wo die Grenze liegt, wenn Ergebnisse aus unterschiedlichen Systemen keine gemeinsame Zahl ergeben.

Am Ende steht die Frage, an der sich Retail Media im Handel entscheidet: Wie wird aus einzelnen Wirkungsnachweisen ein Mediaprodukt, das gemeinsam planbar, buchbar und messbar ist?

speakers.name: Léonie Hönisch
speakers.jobTitle: Senior Connected Media Planning Manager DACH

speakers.name: Frederik Horst
speakers.organization: INOVISCO Mobile Media GmbH & DIGOOH Media GmbH

title: Warum Unternehmen täglich Zeit und Markenwert verschenken – und wie DOCUNIZE das beendet.
description: Jede E-Mail, jede Präsentation und jede digitale Visitenkarte ist eine Chance, die eigene Marke zu stärken oder Markenwert zu verschenken. Dennoch kämpfen viele Unternehmen mit inkonsistenter Kommunikation, manuellen Prozessen und fehlender Kontrolle über ihre Corporate Identity. Dieser Vortrag zeigt, wie moderne Unternehmen ihre digitale Markenpräsenz zentral steuern, Brand Awareness an jedem Touchpoint erhöhen und gleichzeitig wertvolle Zeit sparen. Anhand konkreter Beispiele erfahren Sie, wie DOCUNIZE digitale Kommunikation effizient, konsistent und markenstark gestaltet.

title: The Golden Age of AI Creativity?! If AI Creates Everything, What Makes Anything Great?
description: Generative tools have removed most of the old excuses. Budget, timeline, craft: the barriers that used to decide what got made are gone or shrinking fast. What is left is judgment. An artist, a platform and a brand meet on stage to argue about where quality comes from now, how anyone escapes the sameness that follows shared tools and shared models, and who gets the final call when a machine can produce a hundred plausible versions of the same idea.

speakers.name: Michalina Seekamp
speakers.jobTitle: Head of Content & Creator Sales YouTube

title: Was kostet Nicht-Investieren? Das BVDW AI Value Framework für die Digitale Wirtschaft
description:
Trotz milliardenschwerer Investitionen in Künstliche Intelligenz bleibt der messbare Mehrwert häufig hinter den Erwartungen zurück. Der Engpass liegt dabei selten in der Technologie, sondern in der Fähigkeit, den Wertbeitrag von KI ganzheitlich zu bewerten.

Das BVDW AI Value Framework schafft dafür einen strukturierten Ansatz. Es macht den Beitrag von KI entlang von verschiedenen Wertdimensionen sichtbar: von finanziell über qualitativ und befähigend bis zu mitarbeiterbezogen. Statt einer eindimensionalen ROI-Betrachtung ermöglicht das Modell einen differenzierten Blick auf Wirkung, Potenziale und Wertschöpfung.

Die Masterclass zeigt, wie Unternehmen KI-Initiativen fundierter bewerten, Business Cases belastbarer aufsetzen und den Übergang von Pilotprojekten zur Skalierung erfolgreich gestalten können.

title: Transaction Horizon: How payment and fulfilment are converging – and why this will be the key competitive issue over the next five years
description:
Retail is actually quite simple: the money arrives. The goods arrive. Payment and fulfilment form the operational backbone of every transaction, yet in many companies they are still treated as separate processes.

By 2026, this structural flaw will become more costly. Agentic Commerce delegates purchasing decisions to AI agents that optimise based on price, delivery time and availability. The Instant Economy is raising expectations on both sides. And personalised payment experiences – from BNPL and digital wallets to loyalty-based checkouts – are becoming a key differentiator in their own right.

This panel explores how retailers, platforms and payment providers are integrating these developments. And how current trends and developments are transforming the industry.

speakers.name: Carina Lamb
speakers.jobTitle: Principal Analyst, Commerce Media & Retail, UK & Western Europe

speakers.name: Carola Wahl
speakers.jobTitle: Vice President, General Manager PayPal Germany, Austria and Switzerland

title: Der Plattform-Vorteil: Warum First-Party den offenen Markt schlägt
description: Der offene Werbemarkt steht zunehmend unter Druck, wenn es um Effizienz und präzise Zielgruppenansprache geht. First-Party auf Plattformen ermöglicht relevantere In-Category-Kontakte und eine deutlich höhere Datenqualität entlang der Customer Journey. Die Session zeigt, wie sich dadurch die Zusammenarbeit zwischen Agenturen, OEMs und Plattformen weiterentwickelt.

title: Game. Set. Replatformed: Wie Tennis-Point Enterprise Commerce neu gedacht hat
description:
Was braucht es, um einen der führenden Tennis-Retailer Europas in ein modernes, skalierbares Commerce-Powerhouse zu verwandeln? Tennis-Point hat die Antwort.

In dieser Masterclass berichtet Marius Grewe von Tennis-Point gemeinsam mit DEPT® und Shopify, wie sie eine Dekade an Legacy-Komplexität hinter sich gelassen und ein Fundament für die Zukunft gebaut haben. Von der strategischen Entscheidung, über 14 Märkte zu migrieren – und eine gesamte Organisation mitzunehmen – bis hin zu den konkreten Ergebnissen: 30-35 % niedrigere Plattformkosten, bessere Checkout-Performance und ein Setup, das endlich mit dem Business wächst statt es zu bremsen.

Was dich erwartet? Kein Theorie-Talk. Keine Hochglanz Case-Study. Sondern ein ehrlicher Blick hinter die Kulissen einer der komplexesten Commerce-Transformationen im europäischen Sporthandel – und was andere Enterprise-Retailer daraus mitnehmen können.

speakers.name: Marius Grewe
speakers.jobTitle: Senior Technical Product Owner - Commerce Platform

title: Gekauft ist nicht gewonnen: Vom hochpersonalisierten Mailing zum 360°-Loyalty-Erlebnis bei INTERSPORT
description: Vom perfekten Onboarding für frischgebackene E-Biker bis hin zu motivierenden Treuepunkte-Kampagnen für Wander-Fans: Begleite die INTERSPORT-Kund:innen durch unterschiedliche Saisons und erlebe, wie über E-Mail, Push und Co. aus einem Erstkauf dauerhafte Loyalty wird. Persönliche Interessen, saisonale Impulse und intelligente Trigger greifen auf Basis einer zentralen Kundensicht perfekt ineinander und erzielen bis zu 150 % Uplift in der Öffnungsrate.

title: Beyond the TV: How Heineken & Teads Mastered CTV HomeScreen to Drive Brand Lift
description:
Ready to unlock the most high-attention ad space on the TV? Join Teads and Heineken as they share exclusive data from their global learning agenda, revealing exactly how to build creatives that win on the CTV HomeScreen. Moving past industry assumptions, they’ll break down the specific rules of layout, video length, and motion that drive real brand growth.

Key Takeaways:

CTV Homescreen is a massive driver of attention and brand lift. In this study Homescreen delivered 2.3x Ad Awareness Lift vs Brand norms
Longer Beats Shorter: Why 10–15+ second storytelling assets consistently outperform short product clips on the big screen.
Radically Simple Design: How to successfully deploy split-screen and static layouts without cluttering the user experience.
The Power of Omnichannel: Evidence on why sequencing CTV and mobile moves mid-funnel brand metrics faster than siloed channels.

title: AI-native creative workflows: The era of creative AI architects
description:
Generative AI has made creative production dramatically easier. But for brands, the harder challenge remains: knowing what to create, why it should work, and how to scale that intelligence across every campaign, channel and market.

The next phase of creative AI will not be won through better prompts or disconnected tools. It will be built through AI-native creative systems that bring together audience insight, brand knowledge, competitive intelligence, platform context, human judgment and automated execution.

In this masterclass, Anurag Dwivedi, Rocketium's co-founder and CPO will show what these workflows look like in practice, from research and creative decision-making to generation, adaptation and review. We will also introduce the emerging role of the Creative AI Architect: the person responsible for designing how people, agents, data and creative infrastructure work together.

The goal is no longer simply to scale creative production. It is to scale the intelligence behind creative.

title: DA Direkt / Zurich Insurance: 800% ROI in 3 Months. What Happens When AI Optimizes Your Media Budget?
description:
How do you know where your next media euro will really drive incremental growth?

 

Christoph Rüppel, Head of Performance Marketing at DA Direkt / Zurich Insurance, and Marco Hochstrasser, Co-Founder & CEO of Nexoya, reveal the playbook behind 800% ROI in just 3 months.

 

Learn how to assess where your media setup stands today and move step by step from fragmented attribution to AI-driven optimization: optimize budgets across channels and campaigns, and use forecasts & trend signals to make decisions before results land.

 

Walk away with a simple maturity check: where you are today, what to fix first, and when you're ready to let AI take over more media decisions. Plus: what changes next when AI agents enter the loop.

 

An award-winning Zurich Innovation Championship case, with lessons you can apply to your own media setup.

title: Von online bis in den Store – wie eine Idee Wachstum über alle Kanäle hinweg erzeugte
description: In der Masterclass wird gezeigt, wie BSH Hausgeräte im Rahmen einer Promotion für ausgewählte Bosch Waschmaschinen mit Ariel die Omnichannel-Kompetenz von MediaMarktSaturn Retail Media & Partner Marketing nutzt. Die Kampagne ist über zahlreiche digitale und physische Touchpoints hinweg präsent und begleitet die Kundinnen und Kunden konsistent entlang ihrer Customer Journey. Doch was macht aus einer erfolgreichen Omnichannel-Kampagne einen Best Practice Case? Die Antwort gibt es in der Masterclass.

speakers.name: Ramona Reuters
speakers.jobTitle: Head of Retail Media, Central Sales

title: Cut through the noise: Creating distinctive AI-driven content
description:
AI can generate content at unprecedented speed. The challenge is making that content distinctive, consistent and unmistakably on-brand.

Join Valtech and Sitecore in this high-impact session to explore how to turn AI-powered efficiency into a competitive advantage. Learn how brand guidelines can be translated into distinctive, scalable content that consistently captures your voice, tone and identity across every touchpoint.

Walk away with practical ideas to scale distinctive AI experiences, maintain brand consistency and explore what's possible through hands-on demonstrations.

title: Big-Screen-Werbelösungen für cross-country und nationale Erfolge – mit Produktpremiere
description:
Aufmerksamkeit ist die neue Währung. Während Konsument:innen auf dem Smartphone im Sekundentakt mit KI-generierten Inhalten bombardiert werden, schenken sie dem Big Screen ihre volle Aufmerksamkeit.

National oder europaweit: Der Big Screen bietet enormes Reichweitenpotenzial. Reichweite, die wirkt. Wir zeigen Euch mit einfach anwendbaren Produkten, wie Ihr Skalierung und Akzeptanz für jede Kampagnengröße nutzt.

Das Besondere: Ihr seid bei der europäischen Premiere eines neuen Reichweitenprodukts dabei, das an diesem Tag startet.

Für Media-Agenturen, Brands und Mediabuyer, die praktische Insights mit nach Hause nehmen möchten.

title: AI Is Hungry. What Are You Feeding It? Why AI needs social to know who to trust
description:
Every brand is asking what it can get out of AI. Maybe we should spend a little more time asking what we are putting into it.

AI can create more content than any of us know what to do with. What it cannot create is genuine authority. For that, it still needs people.

The experts sharing what they know. The creators people choose to listen to. The customers swapping experiences. The communities answering questions brands cannot answer for themselves. Much of that happens on social, and AI is increasingly reading those conversations too.

The lecture looks at what happens when social is no longer just a feed for people, but part of the material AI uses to understand who and what is credible. There is a slightly uncomfortable implication for marketers here: creating more content is not necessarily the answer.

Moving from the explosion of synthetic content, through AI's growing dependence on human source material, to the changing role of social, we will look at why the next era of brand authority will not be won by creating more content, but by building the voices, conversations and communities worth paying attention to.

Because whilst AI can surface credibility; people have to create it.

title: Manual Amazon Reporting is Dead – Spare Zeit, frag deine Daten
description: Say goodbye to manual Amazon reporting: How MCP and AI are revolutionizing the analysis of advertising data—without any copy-pasting or Excel chaos. Just ask, and get answers instantly.

title: Von Online-Werbung zu Offline-Umsatz: Wie ROSSMANN Retail Media und Beiersdorf den ROPO-Effekt messbar machen
description: Digitale Retail-Media-Kampagnen wirken nicht nur online, sondern beeinflussen auch den stationären Abverkauf. Doch wie lässt sich dieser Effekt sauber nachweisen? ROSSMANN Retail Media und Beiersdorf zeigen anhand eines gemeinsamen Cases, wie Online-Kontakte mit Offline Sales verbunden werden können und welche neuen Erkenntnisse daraus für Marken, Händler und die Weiterentwicklung von Retail Media entstehen. Im Fokus steht der nachgewiesene ROPO-Effekt: Research Online, Purchase Offline. Ein Praxisbeispiel dafür, wie Messbarkeit im Retail Media neu gedacht wird und warum Offline Sales zu einem entscheidenden Erfolgsindikator werden.

title: CMO CONNECT @ DMEXCO: The Challenger Advantage: Winning in the AI Era
description:
+++ REQUEST YOUR INVITE +++

AI is changing more than how marketing is made

it is changing how businesses compete. Sir Martin Sorrell and Giuseppe Fiordispina of CUPRA explore what it takes to win when speed, agility, and continuous adaptation matter as much as scale. From AI adoption and real-time marketing to changing consumer behaviour and new operating models, they’ll examine whether the next era belongs to incumbents with resources and data, or challengers with less legacy and more freedom to move. The conversation will cut through the AI hype to ask a more important question: what do leaders need to change now to build faster, more adaptive, and more competitive businesses?

Request participation

title: Who Owns Discovery? E-Commerce 2030
description:
Who decides which brands will still be discovered tomorrow? The discussion will focus on how E-Commerce and brands’ digital sales strategies need to evolve as discovery increasingly takes place through AI, social media and platforms, while the traditional customer journey continues to fragment.

Register Now for a Roundtable

title: 25 Years of AI in Advertising: What's Actually Changed and What's Next
description: Neal Richter has been building AI systems since 1999 — before "machine learning" was a buzzword, before programmatic existed, before anyone imagined AI writing ad copy. In this keynote, Neal takes the DMEXCO audience on a journey through 25+ years of AI evolution in advertising: from early data mining and recommendation engines, through the programmatic revolution and real-time bidding, to today's generative and agentic AI. With the unique perspective of someone who has lived every chapter, Neal separates hype from reality, shares what actually changed the industry, and offers a grounded, credible vision of what the next five years will bring.

title: Empfänger unbekannt. Was Konsumenten über Innovation und KI denken. Erkenntnisse aus dem Innovationsindex 2026
description: Empfänger unbekannt? Unternehmen schicken immer neue Innovationen auf den Weg – doch ob sie ankommen, entscheiden die Kunden. Während alle über KI und Agentic Commerce reden, fragt der Innovation Perception Index 2026 deshalb 2.001 repräsentativ ausgewählte Konsumenten: Was überzeugt wirklich? Die Antworten sind eindeutig: Nutzen zählt mehr als Neuheit, einfache Bedienung schlägt einen niedrigen Preis und Offenheit schließt Sorgen nicht aus. Prof. Dr. Daniela Wiehenbrauk und Sandra Baethge zeigen Stellhebel, mit denen Innovationen ihre Empfänger erreichen.

title: Die „Data-to-Profit“-Pipeline: Wie lässt sich Google Analytics 4 mit KI zu einem ultimativen Wachstumsmotor kombinieren?
description:
Daten und Tools sind genug vorhanden aber die entscheidende Frage ist, wie daraus systematisch Wachstum entsteht.

Inna erklärt uns in dieser Session, wie man Google Analytics 4 als saubere Entscheidungsgrundlage nutzt, KI für smartere Analysen, Prognosen und Skalierung einsetzt und du dafür sorgst, dass aus Traffic auch messbar mehr Umsatz wird.

Statt isolierter Maßnahmen geht es um eine durchgängige Pipeline von Daten über Insights und Tests bis hin zu Profit. Anhand praxisnaher Use Cases erfährst du, welche Setups wirklich helfen. Der Vortrag richtet sich an alle, die Performance Marketing nicht nur optimieren, sondern nachhaltig und systematisch skalieren wollen.

title: AI entlastet den E-Commerce-Support
description: Wie AI Routineanfragen im E-Commerce automatisiert, Support-Teams entlastet und Kundenservice schneller skalierbar macht.“

title: Dear Future - What kind of world are we building?
description: In her keynote, Lara takes the audience on a journey from understanding technology to shaping its impact. She translates the most important technology trends into a clear picture of what is happening now and what comes next, explores how companies can move from AI experimentation to real implementation and measurable business value, and looks beyond the corporate perspective at the broader implications of AI for work, human behavior and society. At its core, the keynote connects technology, business and people – making the future not only understandable, but actionable.

title: The DMEXCO Adtech Summit
description:
The DMEXCO AdTech Summit 2026 highlights the key developments transforming today’s advertising ecosystem: AI-driven automation, the decline of third-party cookies, and the rise of new privacy-focused data strategies.

With AI increasingly handling tasks such as bidding, targeting, and campaign optimization, marketers have more freedom to focus on creativity and strategic planning.

At the same time, the fading relevance of traditional tracking methods is driving advertisers to invest in first-party data, contextual targeting, and new identity frameworks.

Topics such as curated marketplaces, supply chain transparency, and the rapid growth of Connected TV underscore the industry’s push for greater accountability and stronger performance metrics. Advances in 5G and real-time data are also fueling a strong comeback for location-based and contextual advertising.

The AdTech Summit brings together industry leaders and innovators to discuss how data, technology, and regulation are reshaping digital marketing in Europe and beyond.

title: Media ist Chefsache: Wie CMOs Transparenz, Kontrolle und Verantwortung zurückgewinnen
description:
Mediaplanung wird immer komplexer: KI-Systeme treffen Entscheidungen, Plattformen liefern eigene Erfolgskennzahlen und Agenturmodelle verändern sich. Doch wie behalten Werbungtreibende den Überblick? Das Panel diskutiert, welche Transparenz Marken heute einfordern müssen, welche KPIs unabhängig überprüft werden sollten und wie sich Verantwortung zwischen Unternehmen, Agenturen und Technologieanbietern künftig sinnvoll verteilt.

Moderation: Frank Puscher, MEEDIA

Mit BVDW Bundesverband Digitale Wirtschaft, Ebiquity, tk-one

title: How to thrive in the messy middle of AI transformation? | A Live Conversation Between a Brand and Its Agency, Mid-Experiment
description:
Every CMO and agency leader knows the double bind: fear of falling behind on AI, and fear of falling short because of it – both at once, permanently. That's because the finish line keeps moving. Every time you master one generation of AI, the ground shifts again.

This session offers a different way through: a fixed north star – a clear answer to what you actually want AI to do for your organization – that lets you experiment constantly and scale fast, without the chaos.

It's grounded in a real client-agency partnership: BSH and Iris Germany didn't bolt AI onto an existing process – they rebuilt the process, the roles, and the relationship, creating efficiencies without capping creative ambition. Now they're going further, making the case that the next chapter isn't more automation – it's using AI to become more relevant to people in the moment they're deciding.

This is a candid, numbers-backed look at what's working, what isn't, and what's next.

title: From Social Media to Mass Market: How More Nutrition Scales with TV & Premium Video
description:
Known for its functional food products, More Nutrition built its brand through social media. Around a year ago, the company took the next step in its growth journey by expanding its media strategy to include TV and premium video.

In this interview, Patrycja Nowakowska, General Manager of More Nutrition, shares the brand’s experience through the lens of a recent product launch. Find out how big screen media can drive impact across the marketing funnel – from awareness and consideration to purchase-related metrics.

 

This session is especially relevant for direct-to-consumer brands, startups and scale-ups looking to reach their next stage of growth, as well as agencies supporting clients on their scaling journey.

title: How non-gaming brands activate gamers at GameStar’s FYNG gamescom 2026
description: gamescom has evolved into a true gaming festival with over 360.000 visitors. GameStar's FYNG gamescom event offers smart activation of the gaming audience on site with full 360° amplification to web, social & video. Learn how Mercedes-Benz and Ferrero Duplo connect with Germany's biggest gaming media GameStar to activate the gaming audience in a smart way across all channels, natively.

title: Winning the mental shelf: how consumers decide what gets bought, and where
description:
Marketing budgets cluster at two ends: brand building for the long term, and activation at the point of sale, increasingly via retail media. In between sits the phase where intent turns into a concrete shopping list — the point of planning. On the sofa, in front of the fridge, while browsing offers. By the time shoppers reach the store, most of the basket is already set. It is the most underrated moment in the shopper journey and connects mental with physical availability.

Based on Ehrenberg-Bass research and first-party data from Bring!, Europe's largest shopping list platform — with more than 1.5 billion products bought per year — this talk shows how planning moments can now be identified and predicted through data and delivers two compact and actionable playbooks for turning shopper intent into business impact: one for FMCG, one for retail.

title: Shopping missions: A sharper lens on customer behaviour
description: It's long been accepted that growing existing customers is easier than winning new ones, yet in retail this potential is hard to capture. Chasing it with generic, blanket incentives is expensive: most of the reward subsidises purchases that would have happened anyway, and with retail's thin margins that can quickly undermine the economics. The key is to nudge the right customers in the right way. This session looks at "shopping missions" as a sharper lens on customer behaviour and an enabler of specific incentives, driving a concrete behavioural response, while solving the dead-weight-loss problem of generic incentives.

title: You should probably fire your e-commerce agency. At least the version of it you hired five years ago.
description:
The honest test for agency value in the age of AI.

Platforms like Shopware are taking on more and more standard functionality—and that’s a good thing. Clients shouldn’t have to pay agencies to keep rebuilding what the platform can already do. As a result, the value an agency provides must shift more toward business acumen, architecture, orchestration, and measurable impact.

title: BMW Germany & Taboola Drive Intelligent Advertising Tech to Launch a New Era
description:
With the Neue Klasse, BMW is taking the next major step in electrification, digitalization and customer experience, as the new BMW iX3 brings key technologies of this next vehicle generation to the road. BMW Germany orchestrates the customer journey across touchpoints to turn this technological step-change into more relevant, measurable and efficient customer engagement.  A transformation of this magnitude lives or dies on execution. It requires reaching the right audiences at an unprecedented scale. In a fragmented digital landscape, how do you move beyond relying on past success to engage new audiences that will define your brand’s next era?

Join Susanna Eiber (Head of Marketing Germany, BMW) and Krishan Bhatia (Chief Business Officer, Taboola) to unpack the commercial realities of this defining launch. Moving past AI experimentation to drive true business value, they will explore what happens when creative conviction meets predictive intelligence, and offer a candid look at how to drive scalable acquisition when the traditional playbook of search and social is no longer enough.

title: Stop Wasting Your Time And Other People's Money
description:
Marketing is in trouble: 87% of campaigns lose money while over 100 billion USD each year are burned on ad fraud... and the worst is yet to come as AI bots flood the web making up the majority of traffic and content and occluding authentic signals, while agentic commerce undermines core mechanisms of online marketing and e-commerce. To add insult to injury, headcount in advertising is declining while touchpoints proliferate.

We cannot continue in the old paradigm or we will all lose.

The good news: Analytic AI is ready to help, here and now - providing marketing with a navigator that detects trustworthy signals, cuts through the noise, reveals trends and success drivers and recommends the best actions. Finally independent from cookies and publisher data, marketers now have the perfect companion to predict markets (demand, competition), prioritize options (products, topics, locations, channels, influencers, leads) and optimize programs (roas attribution, media mix modeling, lead generation).

So stop wasting your time and other people's money - by focusing on what really generates value. NEUTRUM got your back.

title: The decision gap: New Research into the Default Effect in Advertising
description: Join Lukas Fassbender as he explores where marketers may be overlooking growth opportunities. Drawing on new research, this keynote challenges some of the assumptions shaping modern media planning.

speakers.name: Lukas Fassbender
speakers.jobTitle: SVP EMEA at The Trade Desk

title: When Chicken Starts Beef: The KFC Krispy Kebab Story
description: KFC launched the Krispy Kebab, its own take on Germany's most beloved street food, with a campaign built around one honest confession: yes, we stole it. The centrepiece was a cover of the Prinzen classic "Alles nur geklaut" with the tagline "stolen from the best, rebuilt with Fried Chicken." Then a Bielefeld Döner chain that had trademarked the name Krispy Kebab since 2017 went public with a legal challenge and what started as a product launch turned into a nationwide PR moment. KFC moved fast, resolved the dispute on Sonnenallee with a creative peace deal and turned an unexpected plot twist into proof that the best brand entertainment today starts with speed, cultural awareness and the confidence to lean into the moment.

title: The AI Revolution in Retail Media: Shaping the Next Era of Consumer Engagement and Commerce
description:
Artificial intelligence is changing how consumers discover, evaluate, and buy, and how retailers and brands engage them along the way. Recommendation engines, predictive targeting and automated campaign management are already part of daily practice in Retail & Commerce Media. At the same time, AI assistants and shopping agents are beginning to search, compare and select on behalf of consumers, which puts the familiar path to purchase of search results, product pages and sponsored placements up for renegotiation.

This panel asks what the next era of consumer engagement means for the people who build and buy retail media. Retail Media Networks have grown on owned touchpoints and first-party data. When an AI interface writes the shortlist, visibility inside that recommendation becomes the new shelf space, and the commercial rules for it are still being written. Panelists will share where AI already delivers measurable value today, where its limits are, and how sponsored visibility can work in conversational and agentic environments.

The session also takes on the harder questions. What happens to measurement when clicks and impressions lose their meaning? How does power shift between platforms, retailers, brands, and agencies? And which data foundations and transparency standards does the industry need so that advertising in AI-driven journeys stays accountable and trusted?

title: Create once, inspire for longer:  How creators turn ideas into action on Pinterest
description: Creators have never had more ways to make content—yet the real opportunity is making work that stays relevant, gets discovered and creates meaningful impact. In this session you'll get a behind-the-scenes view of how Pinterest works with creative communities, brands and creators. You'll explore how creators can turn their distinct expertise and point of view into content that people discover, save and act on over time.

title: Sichtbarkeit in AI Search: So landet Eure Marke in der KI-Suche
description:
Generative KI verändert die Spielregeln digitaler Sichtbarkeit. Entscheidend ist nicht mehr, gefunden zu werden, sondern als vertrauenswürdige Quelle in KI-basierten Suchumgebungen berücksichtigt zu werden.

Diese Masterclass zeigt, wie Unternehmen ihre Sichtbarkeit systematisch messen und gezielt verbessern können. Im Fokus stehen aktuelle Best Practices für Generative Engine Optimization (GEO), die Anforderungen moderner KI-Suchsysteme sowie die Faktoren, die darüber entscheiden, welche Marken und Inhalte in KI-generierten Antworten erscheinen.

Unsere Expert*innen geben Orientierung für den Umgang mit den neuen Such- und Informationssystemen und teilen, wie sich digitale Sichtbarkeit unter den Bedingungen der KI-gestützten Suche nachhaltig sichern lässt.

speakers.name: Sebastian Grantz
speakers.jobTitle: Global AI & Privacy Lead, Industry Relations

title: The ghost in the org chart: Who actually manages your AI workforce?
description:
+++ REQUEST YOUR SEAT HERE +++

AI agents are already at work across marketing, service, product and operations, but in most organizations, the operating model hasn’t caught up. Join this executive roundtable to explore who owns, governs and orchestrates your AI workforce, when humans need to stay in control and how to measure its impact on customer experience, brand and growth.

title: SPORT1 ALL ACCESS: Das Playbook hinter dem Doppelpass
description: Sonntag der Doppelpass, Montag ein Artikel, Dienstag ein Social-Clip – und dann fängt die nächste Geschichte schon an. SPORT1 zeigt an einer echten Doppelpass-Woche, wie das Thema Fußball über 7 Tage plattformübergreifend Millionen begeistert. Über Social Media, Podcasts und TV hinweg entsteht ein einzigartiges Markenerlebnis. Andreas Gerhardt und Romeo Edsperger machen live sichtbar, was das für Marken bedeutet und warum SPORT1 längst nicht mehr in Sendungen denkt, sondern in Sportgeschichten, die mediumunabhängig sind.

title: Future of Search & Agentic Commerce: Is your E-Commerce-Setup ready for the next era of AI?
description: Today’s consumers are no longer just searching—they are interacting with intelligent assistants. The customer journey is rapidly evolving from classic search queries toward "Agentic Commerce," where AI actively advises, prepares, or even executes purchasing decisions on behalf of users. As a result, traditional sales funnels are officially obsolete. We are presenting you with a clear blueprint for this New Commerce Ecosystem. Learn how to leverage the Gemini advantage to not only stay visible in the "Future of Search" but also feed the AI the exact signals it needs. Learn from practical setups on how to use AI-powered campaigns like AI Max to not only capture demand but actively generate new buying interest in a world of autonomous assistants. Are you ready to scale your sales growth in the era of AI agents?

description:
Gutes Wetter in den Niederlanden? Dann läuft die Kampagne, sonst nicht. Weischer.OOH und Weischer.Connect zeigen am Case des NBTC (Niederländisches Büro für Tourismus und Convention), wie eine DCO-Mechanik Programmatic DOOH, Social und Display aus einer einzigen Datenquelle steuert.

Mit Weischer.Connect, Weischer.OOH

title: Sovereign by Design: Women Building the AI Europe Can Trust
description: Sovereign AI isn't only a test of who builds it. It's a test of who trusts it and who uses it, and now we can measure both. Europe is betting billions on owning its own AI, but ownership doesn't imply inclusive adoption. Only 40% of consumers trust AI with complex tasks, and across five European markets, women are using it less than men. In July, Europe's AI Act made it legal to test whether AI works fairly. Together with new Kantar research across Germany, the UK, France, Italy and Spain, we'll unpack what actually earns consumer trust, and which claim sells better: built in Europe, or built to work fairly.

title: Ad Fraud & Bot Traffic – Brauchen wir ein Human Targeting?
description:
Bis zu 30 % der digitalen Werbebudgets versickern in Ad Fraud – oft unbemerkt und zunehmend KI-getrieben.

JOM-Managing Director Sai-Man Tsui zeigt, wie Betrug im Programmatic Advertising, bei Display, Video und besonders im wachsenden CTV-Umfeld funktioniert, warum klassische Erkennung an ihre Grenzen stößt, und mit welchem praxisnahen Dreiklang aus Bewusstsein, geprüften Partnern und technischer Kontrolle Werbetreibende ihre Budgets wirksam schützen können.
